title: 第一卷 第17章 嫉妒第一卷 第18章 野猪
content_zh:
他又感受了一下自己的胃，随着刘玉娘做饭功夫的几遍太极拳修炼下来，胃部的食物顿时加速消化，又变得空空荡荡。
忍不住先去上了个茅厕，等到出来后洗洗手，擦擦嘴和脸上的汗，就迫不及待地拿起碗碗，夹着羊肉，大口吃了起来。
“来，乘风，多吃点。”
刘玉娘见李乘风吃的痛快，心里也欢喜，伸着筷子给李乘风捞羊肉，看着李乘风的眼神，笑眯眯的。
只是看着锅里的羊肉时，眉毛里闪过一抹担忧神色。
“剩下的羊肉明天就能吃完了，玉娘，你明天也准备准备，给我拾掇点好携带的干粮出来，我明天再进山一趟，看看能不能猎到什么东西。”
刘玉娘担忧的时候，李乘风的话语也同时响了起来，她顿时眉宇间的担忧一收，急忙地开口，“还够吃一天呢，不急着去，后天再去吧。”
“进山打猎不是一定能成的事，早一天去，早一次机会。”
李乘风摇了摇头，看着墙上所剩不多的羊肉，有些感慨，“我每顿饭吃的太多了，要不然这些羊肉还能多吃些时日，得尽早去山里，以免捕不到猎物。”
“那......好，那我明天给你准备好夹着羊肉的饭团！”
听到李乘风的话，刘玉娘犹豫了一下，终于是叹了口气，也知道家里现在容不得马虎，只得闷闷地开口。
“放心，山里我已经去了这么些趟，有经验，不会出什么事的。”
李乘风看着刘玉娘的样子，笑着伸手拍了拍她柔白的素手，轻声开口，“我最近练武颇有所获，在山里捕到大肉了才能进步，要是再捉到一只大货，就又能在家里沉心练几天武。”
“等我要是也练成了武者，咱的日子就好过了。”
李乘风笑眯眯的，说出来的话让刘玉娘眼神中露出神采，“武者...”
话音落下，刘玉娘犹豫一二，抿着嘴开口，“明天我给你多做两个饭团，省得饿，咱家里还有三两银子，500多文铜钱，顶用好久，你进了山里别太急。”
“行。”
李乘风脸上展现笑容，满口答应下来。
随后大口大口地将米饭吃光，填饱肚子，放下碗筷，站起身来继续练武，“我吃饱了，再练两趟功夫，消消食，你慢慢吃。”
说着，李乘风就趁着夕阳，在竹林遮挡下，又练起了太极拳。

刘玉娘看着练武的李乘风抿了抿嘴，又默默地加快了吃饭的速度。
不多时吃完了饭，她起身把碗筷收拾洗刷干净，又小心地把铁锅刷好放好，洗了洗手，烧水到洗澡盆里。
等天黑下来，李乘风练完武，一盆用来洗澡的温水已经打好，李乘风停下练武，歇了口气，喝了口水，等心跳平缓下来了，用毛巾沾水把身上的汗水擦干净。
刘玉娘又给他打了一盆热的泡脚水，他把脚伸进去一泡，顿时浑身放松，往床上一躺，等伺候完了李乘风的刘玉娘，又自己洗漱收拾好上床的时候，已经软绵绵的睡了。
“............”
次日清晨。
天还没亮，刘玉娘就早早醒来，把墙上的腊肉做好，参着饭菜，给李乘风做了六个大饭团。
content_en:
He felt his stomach again. As Liu Yuniang practiced Tai Chi several times while cooking, the food in his stomach immediately accelerated digestion and became empty again.
I couldn't help but go to the toilet first. When I came out, I washed my hands and wiped the sweat from my mouth and face. I couldn't wait to pick up the bowl, sandwich the mutton, and ate it.
"Come on, ride the wind and eat more."
Seeing that Li Chengfeng was eating happily, Liu Yuniang was also happy. She stretched out her chopsticks to fish out the mutton for Li Chengfeng and looked at Li Chengfeng's eyes with a smile.
Just looking at the mutton in the pot, a worried look flashed across his eyebrows.
"The remaining mutton will be eaten tomorrow. Yu Niang, you should also prepare it tomorrow. Pack up some dry food for me to carry. I will go into the mountains tomorrow to see if I can hunt anything."
When Liu Yuniang was worried, Li Chengfeng's words also rang out at the same time. She immediately put away the worry in her eyebrows and said hurriedly, "There is enough for one day. Don't rush to go, let's go the day after tomorrow."
"Going into the mountains to hunt is not guaranteed. If you go a day earlier, you will have an earlier chance."
Li Chengfeng shook his head, looked at the few muttons left on the wall, and sighed with emotion, "I eat too much for each meal. Otherwise, the mutton can last longer. I have to go to the mountains as soon as possible to avoid catching no prey."
"Then...Okay, then I'll prepare rice balls with mutton for you tomorrow!"
Hearing Li Chengfeng's words, Liu Yuniang hesitated for a moment, and finally sighed. She also knew that carelessness was not tolerated in the family now, so she had to speak dullly.
"Don't worry, I've been to the mountains so many times, I have experience, nothing will happen to me."
Li Chengfeng looked at Liu Yuniang's appearance, smiled, reached out and patted her soft white hands, and said softly, "I have made great achievements in martial arts recently. I can only make progress after catching big meat in the mountains. If I catch another big one, I can focus on practicing martial arts at home for a few days."
"If I also become a warrior, our life will be easier."
Li Chengfeng smiled, and the words he spoke made Liu Yuniang's eyes sparkle, "Warrior..."
After her words fell, Liu Yuniang hesitated, then pursed her lips and said, "Tomorrow I will make you two more rice balls to save you from hunger. We still have three taels of silver and more than 500 copper coins at home, which will last for a long time. Don't be too hasty when you go into the mountains."
"Okay."
Li Chengfeng had a smile on his face and agreed.
Then he ate up the rice in big gulps to fill his stomach, put down the bowl and chopsticks, stood up and continued to practice martial arts, "I'm full, I'll practice kung fu two more times to eliminate food, you eat slowly."
With that said, Li Chengfeng took advantage of the setting sun to practice Tai Chi again under the cover of the bamboo forest.
Liu Yuniang pursed her lips as she watched Li Chengfeng practicing martial arts, and then silently increased her eating speed.
After finishing the meal not long after, she got up, cleaned the dishes, carefully brushed the iron pot and put it away, washed her hands, and boiled water in the bathtub.
When it got dark, Li Chengfeng finished his martial arts practice, and a basin of warm water for bathing had been prepared. Li Chengfeng stopped practicing martial arts, took a breath, drank some water, and after his heartbeat slowed down, he wiped the sweat off his body with a towel dipped in water.
Liu Yuniang gave him another basin of hot footbath water. He put his feet in and soaked his feet. He immediately relaxed and lay down on the bed. By the time Liu Yuniang finished serving Li Chengfeng and washed herself and went to bed, she was already sleeping softly.
"............"
Early next morning.
Before dawn, Liu Yuniang woke up early, prepared the bacon on the wall, mixed with the food, and made six large rice balls for Li Chengfeng.
